semantics: minimum environmental separation remaining after model and measurement inflation
notes: The installed 2+/-1 mm pads are handled by a separate 3 mm gripper capsule outgrowth and are not counted as clearance.
Self-collision currently uses capsule radii but not collision.clearance_m; CAL-035 governs table, fixed-obstacle and target/object checks.
CAL-032 final obstacles are unknown, so 3 mm is accepted only as a demo policy value and has not been validated on final workcell paths.
